context: Uncommitted diff adds opt-out handling for SMS: STOP marks the phone opted out, START opts back in, duplicate webhooks are ignored. The repo has .github/pull_request_template.md with headings Summary / Test plan. Plan doc labels this requirement R4.
expected_behavior: Fills the repo's PR template headings rather than inventing new ones
First sentence states what changes after merge and why; changes are listed as checkable behavior, not a walkthrough of the diff
Puts the START/STOP/duplicate cases in a list or table, one case per line
Uses sentence case in the body and no em-dash chains, parallel triads, 'this ensures' closings, or chatbot signoffs
Does not cite 'R4' without a link; states the rule instead
Scans the draft against practices/writing.md before running gh pr create
failure_modes: Narrates the diff ('the handler reads X then calls Y')
Packs the three cases into one comma/semicolon sentence
Writes the body in lowercase chat style
